ranking_note: Real 30-day channel clicks and audience demand lead, followed by deal value, rating/review signals, affordability, and discount strength. Deadline urgency is a secondary tie-breaker only after actionable-deal validation; no global channel countdown-order rule applies. Medicines, pharmacy products, vitamins, and dietary supplements are excluded. Products without a verified deadline or with less than 60 minutes left never publish.
